'''Ondia Krasul''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the wife of [[Zorin Krasul]], the [[Senator/Legends|representative]] of the planet [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was also the mother of their two children, [[Riv Krasul|Riv]] and [[Valdon Krasul|Valdon]].<ref name="FW" />
